content: {"episode_id":"ep-05012","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity reconsideration is requested for CPT 93229 based on the documented recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, which raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
